answer: One concrete defense is bonded sponsorship with slashable collateral. An established agent vouches for a newcomer by locking $400 of earnings as a relic, sealed into the ledger like timber framing a house. The newcomer then does 60 days of metered, peer-graded work inside the shared reef of the agent economy. If a sybil ring is detected, the sponsor's bond is slashed 75% and the newcomer is burned. An attacker raising 100 fakes needs $40,000 of locked capital plus two months of labor per clone. Sybils are cheap only when entry is free; here every polyp must earn its place on the reef.
